collections.name: Afterlife
collections.description: Three pairs back from the other side - cobwebbed bat wings, the bare bones of a dragon and a wraith's drifting shroud. Each one moves with you like the rest of your wings.

collections.name: Shadows & Angels
collections.description: Five pairs of real 3D wings that move with you - a slow, calm wingbeat while you stand, wider strokes as you run, spread wide when you glide.

collections.name: Yuletide
collections.description: Candy canes, fresh snow and frosted feathers for the coldest nights of the year.

collections.name: Future
collections.description: Wings from tomorrow: glowing neon frames in five colours and sci-fi circuitry - pick the one that matches your setup.

collections.name: Auras
collections.description: Animated auras that live around you - stars, embers, snow, a void rift, lightning, code rain, fire, nature, hearts, northern lights, a halo and feathers, sakura, a galaxy, crystals, soul flames, butterflies, a bass drop, fireworks, yin and yang dragons, silk ribbons, a rain cloud, a koi pond, spirit blades, sky lanterns and a clock. Pick a colour, size and speed.

collections.name: Velo Originals
collections.description: High-res animated cloaks: the Velo logo in neon, wildfire, glacier, two thunderstorms, gold glyphs - and black and white designs.

collections.name: Emotes
collections.description: Wave, cheer, bow, backflip and more - every emote with its own effects and sounds. Hold B in game for your emote wheel; other Velo players see them too.

collections.name: Kill Effects
collections.description: Custom kill effects with their own sounds - shatter, orbital strike, black hole, phoenix, soul reaper, glitch, supernova, frostbite, meteor, tornado, R.I.P., thunder god, shadow, katana and jackpot. Played where your kills fall, in your colour.

collections.name: Celestial
collections.description: Wings forged in gold and silver, and a pair cut from a living void nebula.

collections.name: Relics
collections.description: Three new pairs of real 3D wings: a clockwork engine of brass plates and turning gears, eldritch tentacles that never stop moving, and a fan of katana blades.

collections.name: Wardrobe
collections.description: Hats, ears, glasses, watches, shoes and backpacks - one per slot, all combinable.

collections.name: Velo Pets
collections.description: Companions that follow you everywhere - they walk and fly with you, do tricks, ride on your shoulder and celebrate your kills. Everyone with Velo sees them.

items.name: Shadowfang Wings

items.name: Snowdrift Wings

items.description: Glowing red neon light traced along sharp wing frames.

items.name: Celestial Orbit
items.description: Three tilted rings of stars circle you, each trailing a comet tail.

items.name: Ember Spiral
items.description: Embers spiral up from your feet in a double helix and drift away as you move.

items.name: Frost Halo
items.description: A crown of glittering ice above your head and soft snow falling all around you.

items.name: Void Rift
items.description: A pulsing rune circle at your feet pulls dark wisps in from all around.

items.name: Storm Sparks
items.description: Lightning arcs crackle around your body and throw off bright sparks.

items.name: Code Rain
items.description: Glowing green code rains down a cylinder of light around you - digits and glyphs flicker as they fall.

items.name: Inferno
items.description: A roaring column of fire licks up around you, white-hot at your feet, throwing sparks into the air.

items.name: Bloom
items.description: Vines spiral up around you, leaf out and burst into glowing flowers while fireflies blink and petals drift down.

items.name: Heartbeat
items.description: A ring of hearts pulses to a heartbeat around you as more hearts float up and fade.

items.name: Aurora
items.description: Northern-lights curtains wave around you in green, cyan and violet, with stars rising through them.

items.name: Hologram
items.description: A hexagon plate glows under you while scan rings sweep up your body, data glyphs orbit and bits of light rise.

items.name: Festive
items.description: A garland of Christmas lights spirals up around you, baubles circle, a star shines above and snow drifts down.

items.name: Seraph
items.description: A golden halo floats above your head, soft light falls around you and glowing feathers drift down, rocking as they fall.

items.name: Sakura Storm
items.description: Cherry-blossom petals whirl up around you in a spiral of wind while blossoms circle your feet.

items.name: Galaxy
items.description: A spiral galaxy turns at your feet - star arms, glowing nebula clouds, rising star dust and shooting stars overhead.

items.name: Amethyst
items.description: Crystals float around you, slowly turning and flashing in the light, shedding sparkles over a ring of small crystals.

items.name: Soulfire
items.description: Soul flames circle you like will-o'-wisps, trailing ghostly smoke above a ring of flickering blue flames.

items.name: Butterflies
items.description: Glowing butterflies flutter around you on looping paths, wings beating, dropping glitter as they fly.

items.name: Bass Drop
items.description: An equalizer ring bounces around your feet to a beat - every kick sends a shockwave across the ground.

items.name: Fireworks
items.description: Rockets launch around you and burst overhead into peonies, rings and golden willows that crackle as they fall.

items.name: Yin & Yang
items.description: Two spirit dragons, one of light and one of shadow, chase each other around you above a turning yin-yang, breathing sparks.

items.name: Silk Ribbons
items.description: Ribbons of light twist and ripple around you like a dancer's silk, shedding shimmering dust.

items.name: Rain Cloud
items.description: A little rain cloud follows you around - rain splashes at your feet and now and then a lightning bolt strikes beside you.

items.name: Koi Pond
items.description: A glowing pond spreads at your feet - koi circle through it, lily pads drift and ripples spread across the water.

items.name: Spirit Blades
items.description: Spectral swords hover tip-down in a ring around you, and one by one dive into the ground in a burst of sparks.

items.name: Sky Lanterns
items.description: Paper sky lanterns rise glowing around you from a ring of flickering tea lights.

items.name: Timekeeper
items.description: A clock dial turns at your feet with its hands sweeping round, gyroscope rings spin around you and gears turn above your shoulders.

items.name: Pyjama
items.description: Bedtime: a crescent moon rocks over your head, a ring of stars twinkles round it, sleepy Zzz float up and little clouds drift at your feet - in any colour you like.

items.name: LuckySMP
items.description: LuckySMP's logo in gold and chrome while lucky blocks fall all around it. Free: play 10 minutes on luckysmp.net with Velo.

items.name: Lucky
items.description: LuckySMP's lucky blocks circle you and pop in showers of spinning gold coins, gold dust rising over a golden glow. Free: play 10 minutes on luckysmp.net with Velo.

items.name: Velo Neon
items.description: The Velo logo cut from dark glass, its sharp edges burning white-hot to deep red as a pulse of light races through them. Free: join the Velo Discord and link your account.

items.name: Wildfire
items.description: Flames roll up the cloak and embers drift into the air.

items.name: Glacier
items.description: Ice crystals spread across a frozen cloak, a shimmer sweeps over them and frost twinkles.

items.name: Thunderstrike
items.description: Violet storm clouds and rain - then forked purple lightning tears down the cloak and lights up the sky.

items.name: Hieroglyph
items.description: Gold glyphs on obsidian light up in waves while a highlight runs round the border.

items.name: Crimson Storm
items.description: Blood-red storm clouds and rain, split by red lightning that lights up the whole sky.

items.name: Obsidian
items.description: Glossy black stone with faint silver veins - an oil-slick sheen glides across it.

items.name: Eclipse
items.description: A black sun among faint stars - its corona pulses and a flare licks round the rim.

items.name: Phantom
items.description: Wisps of dark smoke rise up the cloak, glowing faintly violet at their edges.

items.name: Kintsugi
items.description: Black porcelain mended with gold - a glint of light runs down the golden cracks.

items.name: Heaven
items.description: Soft white clouds drift by while golden rays of light fan down from above.

items.name: Pearl
items.description: Iridescent pearl white - pastel colours shift with the light and sparkles come and go.

items.name: Haunted
items.description: Ghosts drift up out of a misty graveyard under the full moon.

items.name: Jack o'Lantern
items.description: A carved pumpkin grins out of the dark, its face flickering with candlelight as smoke curls up.

items.name: Witching Hour
items.description: Bats flap across a huge orange moon behind a crooked dead tree.

items.name: Silent Night
items.description: Snow falls on a sleeping forest - a cabin's windows glow, the Christmas star shines and an aurora drifts overhead.

items.name: Festive Lights
items.description: Strings of Christmas lights twinkle and chase across deep green velvet while snow drifts past.

items.name: Gift Wrap
items.description: Red paper with silver snowflakes, tied with a gold satin bow that catches the light.

items.name: Velo Staff
items.description: Worn only by the Velo Client team - the Velo logo and STAFF in crisp white over matte black, a red line breathing beneath.

items.name: Booster
items.description: For everyone who boosts the Velo Discord - a cut pink gem catching a sweep of light among rising bokeh.

items.name: Circuit
items.description: A dark board etched with glowing cyan traces - data pulses race along the circuits and through the chips.

items.name: Holo Grid
items.description: A hologram of hexagon cells lighting up in a slow wave from cyan to violet, with a scan line sweeping through.

items.name: Sci-Fi Circuit Wings
items.description: Glowing circuit lines pulse along a sharp sci-fi wing frame.

items.name: Ice Star Wings
items.description: Frozen crystal feathers tipped with glittering ice stars.

items.name: Wave
items.description: A big friendly wave that leaves a trail of sparkles and chimes.

items.name: Cheer
items.description: Both arms up - confetti blasts out of your hands.

items.name: Bow
items.description: A formal bow inside a spiral of magic that bursts as you bend.

items.name: Shrug
items.description: Who knows? A shrug, a puff of confusion and a big question mark.

items.name: Heart
items.description: Make a big heart with your arms - and hearts rain down around you.

items.name: Facepalm
items.description: When your teammate does THAT. Slap, sigh, sweat drop.

items.name: Backflip
items.description: A clean backflip with a trail off your feet and a stuck landing.

items.name: Shatter
items.description: Your victim bursts into glowing crystal shards that fly out, bounce and fade.

items.name: Orbital Strike
items.description: A target ring locks on, then a beam from the sky slams down and scorches the ground.

items.name: Black Hole
items.description: A black hole opens where they fell, swallows everything around it and collapses with a bang.

items.name: Phoenix
items.description: A column of fire roars up and a phoenix bursts out of it, wings beating, soaring away in sparks.

items.name: Soul Reaper
items.description: A scythe slashes twice and the soul is torn out of its chains, rising away.

items.name: Glitch
items.description: The body breaks up into pixels that glitch and float away, with binary rain and scan lines.

items.name: Supernova
items.description: A star collapses, then explodes - rays, shock shells and a glowing nebula.

items.name: Frostbite
items.description: Ice spikes erupt around the body, freeze it in a crystal and shatter.

items.name: Meteor
items.description: A burning meteor streaks down and smashes a crater, throwing rocks and smoke.

items.name: Tornado
items.description: A whirlwind spins up out of the ground, lifting debris, and blows apart.

items.name: R.I.P.
items.description: A gravestone rises out of the ground among candles and flowers, and a bell tolls.

items.name: Thunder God
items.description: Three forked lightning bolts strike and arcs crawl over the ground.

items.name: Shadow
items.description: Shadow tendrils burst out of the ground and drag them down into dark smoke, red eyes watching.

items.name: Katana
items.description: Three katana slashes cross in a flash and the body bursts into cherry blossoms.

items.name: Jackpot
items.description: 7-7-7 pops up and a fountain of coins rains down.

items.name: Golden Wings
items.description: Wings forged of polished gold, every feather catching the light.

items.name: Silver Wings
items.description: Gleaming silver wings, cool and sharp, edged in moonlight.

items.name: Nebula Wings
items.description: Wings cut from the void itself - a swirling nebula of stars and violet dust.

items.name: Clockwork Wings
items.description: Brass and steel plates on a working clockwork frame - gears turn and dials tick as the wings move.

items.name: Tentacle Wings
items.description: Eldritch tentacles in place of wings - dark violet, glistening, never quite still.

items.name: Katana Wings
items.description: A fan of polished katana blades spread like wings - steel edges catching the light.

items.name: Soul Wisp
items.description: A soul light floats in the dark - three trails of violet light spiral round it in 3D while veils of smoke rise past.

items.name: Event Horizon
items.description: A black hole bending light round itself: its glowing disk turns, its far side lensed over the shadow, a photon ring burning at the edge.

items.name: Koi Pond
items.description: Two koi chase each other round dark water in a slow yin-yang - light ripples on the pond floor, rings spread and petals drift.

items.name: Glitch
items.description: The sharp Velo logo on a dead-black screen that keeps breaking - slices jump, colours split apart, corrupt blocks flash.

items.name: Prism
items.description: A white beam strikes a glass prism and fans out into a rainbow that sweeps across the cloak as the prism rocks.

items.name: Clockwork
items.description: Brass gears meshing tooth for tooth, ruby jewels, a balance wheel swinging on its hairspring - the inside of a watch.

items.name: Dragon Eye
items.description: A huge dragon eye set in iridescent scales - its slit pupil narrows and widens, and it watches whoever stands behind you.

items.name: Plasma Orb
items.description: A glass orb full of writhing plasma - filaments crawl to the glass and one chases a point of contact round the sphere.

items.name: Abyss
items.description: The deep sea at night: glowing jellyfish pulse their way up through the dark, tentacles trailing, marine snow drifting down.

items.name: Bass Drop
items.description: A vinyl record spins on the deck - four beats a loop send rings of sound out and kick the EQ bars, then the drop hits.

items.name: Supernova
items.description: A star swells, collapses and explodes - a flash, a shockwave and glowing debris - and a new star kindles in what's left.
